notablePrerequisites:
Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to any creature you control.
You control at least one additional artifact.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any artifact except the creature with Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it is attached to.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
